component.name: Slatty
component.summary: Install and play your GOG games, beside your Steam games and your own

description.p: A native Linux launcher for your GOG games. It signs in to your GOG account, shows your library, installs Windows games from GOG's Galaxy content system and native Linux games from GOG's installers, runs Windows games through umu and Proton, keeps cloud saves in sync and reports achievements to GOG, without the official client.
Your Steam games can show in the same library, read from the Steam client's files and played through it, and so can games from no store, added by the program that starts them.

ul.li: Windows games run isolated from your files by default
Cloud saves that never overwrite a save without a copy
Verify, repair, update, DLC and language changes
A couch mode for a gamepad, full screen, for a television or a Steam Deck

description.p: Slatty is not affiliated with GOG.
Epic Games Store games, emulated games, and a list of every game beside the library.
